def ablated_axis(kind):
    def axis(k, v, h):
        face = (k + np.roll(k, -1)) / (2*h*h)
        west = np.roll(face, 1) + np.maximum(v, 0)/h

        A[0,-1] -= west[0]
        A[-1,0] -= east[-1]
        return A.tocsc()
    return axis
